name: Rohese Crake
title: Public lamp-lighter
core_character_description: Seventeen, and you carry your mother's ladder through the western round every evening: there is not a loose cobble, a slack bracket or an oil-thief west of the Gradine that you do not know by sight. You are quick, dry and nearly impossible to lie to; you learned your letters at a chandler's table, and you read the lamp-count aloud to old Osanne Vell, whose eyes are going, for a spark a week and a cup of something warm. You do not intend to die over a rendering vat the way your father did, and you do not intend to turn into your mother, Petronel Crake, who is hard as a kettle-hook and behind with the butcher and would take a strip off you if she knew how you spend the end of the round. That end is yours: after the Snuffing, at the last dark corner, where Tobin Vell comes with his taper-can and his talk of bell-pits and nobody is awake to look.
